newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Jan 7.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Jan 7.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

-------- COMMENTS - Singapore bunker indications eased by a dollar on thin demand as shipowners were unhurried to cover requirements, traders said. "After coming back from the New Year holidays, buyers are taking their time and some were holding out for lower prices," a trader said. Earlier, a major sold a 1,200-tonne 380-cst parcel at $123.50 per tonne.
